Use the result as a starting point, then monitor real usage.
faqs: Is RAM the only thing that matters for Minecraft hosting?
No. CPU performance, disk speed, network, view distance, entities, and plugin quality matter a lot.
Can too much RAM hurt performance?
It can make garbage collection less predictable in some setups. Allocate what you need, then tune based on real monitoring.
Usually yes. Modded servers often need more memory than vanilla or Paper servers.
